discussion_comments.comment_body: [P2, nonblocking] When the transcript contains base64 images generated by the assistant, each subsequent snapshot writes those same images into fresh temporary directories, accumulating duplicate files until the CLI exits.

Fixed in 94a778f9a. `materializeGeneratedMedia` now caches by a hash of the media type and data, so re-hydrating the same transcript on each snapshot reuses the file it already wrote instead of creating a new temp folder. The cache is cleared together with the folders on exit. Added a test for it.

Fixed in aa52079cc. The sidecar now clears the SDK's public model list cache (newly exported `clearPublicModelsCatalogCache`) when a download finishes and after a delete. The composer already re-fetches the list each time the picker opens, so it picks up the change. Verified against a live Ollama: a copied model was hidden while cached and listed after the clear.

Fixed in 3e546f0: closing a tab drops both diff cache keys for the path (and bumps their read generations), so reopening starts a fresh read. Test holds a diff read open, closes and reopens the tab, and checks a second read is issued and renders.

Fixed in 3e546f0: instead of comparing a counts-based signature, every new repository snapshot marks cached diffs and file contents stale; the active view re-reads while keeping the previous contents on screen so polling does not flash a spinner.

Fixed in d357de26d: a read that is already loading is left alone when a snapshot arrives; if the snapshot marked it stale, the response is kept and one follow-up read runs afterwards. Manual refresh now goes through the same path instead of clearing caches. Test holds a read across a 10s poll with fake timers and checks the late response lands and exactly one follow-up read is issued.
